name: Whiteboard
title: Whiteboard (shared board)
description: A shared, infinite whiteboard kept as small JSON documents: sticky notes, shapes, sections, text, arrows, hand-drawn ink, images, tables, stickers, timers, link cards and live web embeds. People and the agent draw on it together, with comments, live cursors and requests to the agent.
summary: A shared whiteboard for brainstorms, diagrams, retros and planning.
when: The person wants a whiteboard: a brainstorm with sticky notes, a flowchart or architecture diagram, a retro or planning board, a mind map, voting with stickers, or any freeform shared canvas they and the agent can both draw on.
